desc: The legend returns. The once unobtainable GL/SSC. Some rifles aren't just rare — they're legendary. The GL/SSC is both. The original was so unobtainable that only 25 ever reached civilian hands — and even then, builders went to extraordinary lengths just to get close. Now, for the first time, it's available to the general public. The GL/SSC is built around a 12.5" Cold Hammer Forged Government profile barrel on a carbine-length gas system, paired with the iconic free-float RIS II rail and integrated hanger system for full M203 and suppressor compatibility. No workarounds. No compromises. The real thing.
